Task: Bug report: when reading a CSV line, a quoted field that contains a comma, like "Smith, John", is split into two columns. Quoted fields must stay one field (without the quotes), and a doubled quote "" inside a quoted field is one quote character.
Acceptance criteria:
- split_line('1,"Smith, John",3') == ["1", "Smith, John", "3"]
- split_line('"say ""hi""",x') == ['say "hi"', "x"]
- plain lines still split

all checks pass
